expert.name: Eleni
expert.quote: Athens first, islands second. Two days of ruins and then the ferry out feels like the holiday actually begins twice.
expert.tip: Take the morning ferry, not the afternoon one. The meltemi wind picks up after lunch and the crossing is a great deal less pleasant.

summary: Seven days between the mainland and the Cyclades: two nights in Athens with a guided morning on the Acropolis, three on Mykonos for the old town, an island circuit and the beaches, then a last night back in Plaka.
included: Included: 3 nights in Athens and 3 nights on Mykonos with breakfast; private airport and port transfers; ferry tickets between the islands; all sightseeing as listed with entrance fees where stated; daily breakfast; a guided Acropolis and Athens city tour; a Mykonos town walk and island bus tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Schengen visa fees; lunches and dinners unless stated; travel insurance; optional excursions; personal expenses. Hotels are named on confirmation: the operator quotes a standard class rather than fixed properties.
